findings.issue: splitlines() drops line endings/final-newline information while the approval says only enumerated byte differences. With legitimate four RECORD changes, unrelated CRLF or terminal newline differences may not be classified.
findings.remedy: Before reusing comparator as an automatic generic acceptance gate, preserve line endings and compare a reconstructed expected lock to exact new bytes. Add end-to-end compare/manifest and line-ending controls; no demand to rerun environment just for the fixed current historical seal.

findings.issue: Future exact-restoration bullets list downloaded wheel 32 but not ensurepip bundled pip/setuptools wheel two explicitly. Current approval does bind both at 43/45 and S9 at 200; do not call them absent from current run.
findings.remedy: Explicitly carry forward approval §1-2 identities and source/tool hashes; precheck 32 downloaded plus two bundled artifact hashes before venv/install. Same-argv alone is too implicit for a standing authority rule.

findings.issue: Exact RECORD bytes alone do not prove actual test-tool payload bytes. Scientific emit/check hashes scientific installed files but excludes the external pytest_t tree.
findings.remedy: Future restore must compare the installed four test distributions' recorded hashes/sizes to actual files and bind their exact path/manifest; keep RECORD bytes as an additional check. This is a future restoration-completeness point, not evidence that current test files were corrupt.

qualifications: Same-shebang scripts are accepted by broad pip-created category at comparator 233-246; this matches approved category rule but does not prove only shebang changed or exact pip-generated bodies. Do not upgrade report beyond that scope.
Restoration is not approved by this review. Fixed paths, same source hashes, single attempt and budget, no overwrite/fallback; a changed environment needs separate review.
Future emit one plus check one still executes two synthetic optimization/Sobol paths and needs that explicit authorization; old check is not proof of a new process environment.
